thread:
ivy: hey all, first-day onboard build is failing on push to ghcr with 403 and then cache restore times out. running default onboard pipeline on hosted agents. error snippets below. any quick unblocks?

ci-bot: build #1 started on hosted-agent-3

ivy: docker push ghcr.io/redwood/onboard:latest -> ERROR 403 Forbidden

paul: welcome ivy! GH App doesn't give package push rights by default. For onboarding we either request a short-lived onboarding token or switch to a public base so you don't need to push. Which flow do you want?

ivy: short-lived token would be great. how do i request one?

paul: open https://redwood.internal/access-requests and pick "onboard-machine-token" for 1 hour. Put the request ID into the pipeline env ONBOARD_REQ so infra can tie it to the build.

ivy: filed AR-312 and added ONBOARD_REQ. retried login succeeded but later the cache restore step failed: "request canceled while waiting for connection" when downloading from S3.

sarah: that's our intermittent S3 egress hit for hosted agents this morning. Quick unblocks: 1) set cache restore: false in the step so the build continues, 2) use an elastic agent in us-west, or 3) prefetch artifacts using aws cli with your temporary creds.

ivy: switched restore:false and build completed. will update the repo README to recommend public base for onboarding. thx!

docs-bot: opened docs PR to add a troubleshooting note for GHCR 403 + cache egress: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/210
